instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium full shot. On a sunny rooftop under a blue sky, three friends are gathered. In the foreground, the grey-haired man (R2) in a grey t-shirt sits looking to the right and smiling. In the background, the man in the black hat (R4) in a brown shirt and red bandana stands on the left, smiling at the Asian woman (R5) in a white shirt, who stands on the right gesturing and talking to him. Bright daylight casts warm natural tones across the scene.
